review.overall_assessment: The diagram covers many of the core search, query, display, sort, and paging behaviors, but it still has one confirmed semantic defect: the no-results handling is duplicated across torrent and video search with the same action drawn twice. No additional evidence-backed functional omissions are clear from the current diagram.

defects.description: The no-results message action is drawn twice instead of once for the shared exception behavior.
defects.evidence: Both torrent and video search requirements specify the same message for the same exception condition: 'If no results are found on a search it will display a message “No results were found for this search.”' The diagram models this as two separate nodes: N15 under torrent search and N28 under video search.
defects.suggested_action: Model the no-results message as a single shared exception action used by both branches, or merge the duplicate action into one common node reached from both no-results decisions.

strengths: Correctly models separate torrent and video search branches with user-selected tick boxes.
Includes database update actions for torrent and video site databases.
Retrieval/display of torrent and video fields is represented, including seeds/peers for torrent and full video name/length/date for hosting results.
Includes sorting and next-page navigation behaviors for both search types.
Includes the video search split into hosting and link queries, matching the two selectable video modes.

defects.description: Step 'display no results message' is drawn 2 times (N15, N28).
defects.suggested_action: Draw a step shared by several branches once, before the decision or after the branches rejoin.
